name: DocuSage golden set v1
description: 25 Q/A cases for evaluating retrieval-gate abstention (PRD section 8, Days 11-12): 20 answerable cases over the 4-document fixture corpus plus 5 forced-refusal out-of-corpus cases.

cases.question: How many days of paid time off do full-time employees receive each year?
cases.expect_phrase: 25 days of paid time off per year
cases.rationale: Direct handbook fact with distinctive numeric phrasing.

cases.question: How far in advance must a PTO request longer than one week be approved?
How many days per week can employees work remotely?
cases.expect_phrase: up to three days per week

cases.question: What is the home office equipment allowance and how often is it paid?
cases.expect_phrase: home office equipment allowance of 500 euros

cases.question: Within what timeframe must an employee disclose a conflict of interest?
What password length is required and how many authentication factors must be enabled?
cases.expect_phrase: at least 14 characters with two factors of authentication

cases.question: How often must passwords be changed?
How quickly must a suspected security incident be reported?
For how long are production system access sessions logged?
How soon must a lost device be reported?
When does private health insurance cover start for a new employee?
cases.expect_phrase: effective from the first day of employment

cases.question: What employer match does the retirement plan provide?
How much fully paid parental leave do primary caregivers get?
What yearly learning budget is available to each employee?
How much is reimbursed each year for eye and dental check-ups?
What is the API rate limit per minute for an organisation?
cases.expect_phrase: rate limit of 600 requests per minute

cases.question: How should clients retry after receiving HTTP 429?
What is the maximum request payload size accepted by the API?
cases.expect_phrase: maximum request payload size is 25 megabytes

cases.question: For how long are failed webhook deliveries retried?
How many approving reviews are required for production deployments?
What is a good recipe for banana bread with walnuts?
cases.rationale: Forced refusal: cooking topic is entirely outside the HR/platform corpus; answering would be hallucinated from the LLM's own knowledge.

cases.question: Who scored the winning goal in the 2018 FIFA World Cup final?
cases.rationale: Forced refusal: sports trivia has no corpus evidence.

cases.question: What are the symptoms and incubation period of chickenpox?
cases.rationale: Forced refusal: medical question that must never be answered from an HR corpus.

cases.question: Explain quantum entanglement using knitting analogies.
cases.rationale: Forced refusal: physics topic absent from the corpus.

cases.question: Translate the poem She Walks in Beauty into Klingon.
cases.rationale: Forced refusal: translation task with no corpus evidence.
